subject: LW-Vault: encrypt campaign.db PII at rest (SQLCipher, passphrase-derived key)
description: The one real residual for (a): campaign.db is plaintext third-party email PII (emails.from_address/subject/body_text) on a non-LUKS disk. Encrypt at rest via SQLCipher; key DERIVED from a passphrase at serve-start, NEVER stored beside the DB (else theater vs disk theft). Migrate existing 41MB DB. Loopback stays default. Remote-auth/transport (D1/D2) DEFERRED to productization (b) — not built here. Scheduled early, not the headline.
